Image-model bake-off — identical real paper-figure prompts

Same prompt sent to each model via OpenRouter. Reference (blue outline) = the actual image our pipeline generated with native gemini-3-pro-image-preview. Dimensions shown as produced (OpenRouter has no size/aspect param — the only lever is the prompt text).

Key findings

1. Aspect ratio — Gemini (Nano Banana Pro 3 & Nano Banana 2 / 3.1-flash) honor the aspect asked for in the prompt, and are perfectly consistent (same prompt ×3 → identical dims). GPT-5-image, gpt-5.4-image-2 ("GPT image 2"), and old Nano Banana 1 (2.5-flash) ignore it — always 1024×1024 square.

2. Resolution (2K/4K) — a SEPARATE axis from aspect, and only controllable on the native Gemini API via image_config.image_size. Measured across 317 real production figures: 1K → 1584px, 2K → 3168px long edge (exactly 2× linear — 2K genuinely works). OpenRouter cannot reach 2K/4K at all — it has no size param, so gemini-3-pro via OpenRouter is stuck at ~1376–1584px even when the prompt explicitly demands "4K, 3840px". 4K is a real priced native tier ($0.24 vs $0.134 for 1K/2K) but the pipeline is set to "Do NOT use 4K"; a fresh native 4K test is blocked on the depleted Gemini key.

3. Speed — flash ~8s, Pro ~22s, gpt-5-image ~65–95s, gpt-5.4-image-2 ~130–150s (~15× slower).

4. Robustness — on the table prompt (P3 below), every model except Nano Banana Pro refused to draw and returned a markdown text table instead of an image.

Resolution: native image_config vs OpenRouter

OpenRouter gemini-3-pro1376×768✗ capped ~1K✗ capped ~1K

P3: Nucleus-Satellite to Prolog Clause Mapping Table req 21:9

show prompt (1201 chars)
Table format, 4 columns × 7 rows (including header). Column headers: 'RST Relation Type', 'Nucleus Role', 'Satellite Role', 'Prolog Template'. Row 1 (CONDITION): nucleus='Consequent', satellite='Condition (premise)', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {satellite}({X}).'. Row 2 (EVIDENCE): nucleus='Conclusion', satellite='Justification (proof)', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {satellite}({X}).'. Row 3 (CAUSE): nucleus='Result/Effect', satellite='Cause (antecedent)', template='{result}({X}) :- {cause}({X}), temporal_order.'. Row 4 (CONCESSION): nucleus='Main (despite satellite)', satellite='Conceding fact', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {base}({X}), \+ {satellite}({X}).'. Row 5 (ELABORATION): nucleus='Primary', satellite='Detail/Adjunct', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {satellite}({X}). OR independent facts.'. Row 6 (ENABLEMENT): nucleus='Enabled action', satellite='Enabling precondition', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {enabler}({X}), precondition_met({X}).'. Row 7 (EXPLANATION): nucleus='Event/fact', satellite='Reason/cause', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {explanation}({X}).'. Table headers bold, centered. Rows alternating light gray/white background. Font: monospace for templates, sans-serif for text.
